start.dialog: Ahoy there! Legend speaks of Captain Blackfin's treasure, sunk in the Abyssal Trench two centuries ago! His ship, the Midnight Pearl, went down with enough gold to buy a kingdom! I've got an old map, but I can't dive that deep. You look like you can hold your breath!
start.objective: Locate the wreck of the Midnight Pearl in the Abyssal Trench

progress.dialog: You found it! But there's a problem—giant crabs have made the wreck their home! And the treasure chest is locked with a riddle. The map says: 'I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish.' Any ideas?
progress.objective: Solve the riddle to open the treasure chest

complete.dialog: A map! Of course! The chest opens, revealing gold beyond counting! As promised, half is yours! Plus, I found this strange amulet in the captain's quarters—some kind of underwater breathing charm!

party_comments.kade: Treasure hunting! This is what being an adventurer is all about!
party_comments.twist: Salt water ruins my spell components. This had better be worth it.
party_comments.nix7: Marine archaeology: fascinating. Artifact preservation: acceptable.
